options.content:
Enter a user ID, then click a room in **Find This User's Rooms**. Counts and logs below use the selected room and time interval. Discovery includes INFO events regardless of the severity filter. Warnings without room attribution are shown separately.

**Current diagnostics** below query the server now. The time picker does not replay topology or quality samples. Missing selections or expired sessions can return 404. Errors and unavailable observations are not healthy results. Quality sample age is not supplied by the API.

panels.description: Matching log records for the selected room, user, severity and interval. No matching logs does not prove a healthy session or working log ingestion.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | level=~"$log_level" [$__range]))

panels.title: User Log Events

panels.description: Warning and error records attributed to the selected room and user in the selected interval.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | level=~"WARN|ERROR" [$__range]))

panels.title: Warnings and Errors

panels.description: Negotiation, publish and subscribe rejection events attributed to the selected room and user during the selected interval. These are event counts, not distinct failed calls. Older warnings without room context appear separately below.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | event=~"negotiation\\.failed|publish\\.aborted|subscribe\\.rejected" [$__range]))

panels.title: Media Command Failures

panels.description: Transport health changes to disconnected for the selected room and user. Successful connections and WebSocket or user cleanup events are excluded. Multiple transitions can belong to one session.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | event="transport.health.changed" | to="disconnected" [$__range]))

panels.title: Transport Loss Events

panels.description: Room discovery across all retained log levels for this user in the selected interval. Click a room to scope the investigation. Missing room attribution and rooms outside retention cannot appear.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (room_id) (count_over_time({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Find This User's Rooms

panels.description: Event mix for the selected room and user in the selected interval, filtered by severity.

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (event, level) (count_over_time({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | level=~"$log_level" | event!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: User Event Mix

panels.description: Event rate for the selected room and user, filtered by severity.

targets.expr: sum by (event, level) (rate({service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | level=~"$log_level" | event!="" [5m]))

panels.title: User Event Rate

panels.description: Retained logs for the selected room and user during the selected interval. Expand trace_id to open Tempo if that trace was sampled and is still retained.

targets.expr: {service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | level=~"$log_level"

panels.title: Recent User Logs

panels.description: Attributed negotiation, publish and subscribe failures in the selected interval. Expand a log to inspect operation, outcome, error and any SDP details emitted by the runtime.

targets.expr: {service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | event=~"negotiation\\.failed|publish\\.aborted|subscribe\\.rejected"

panels.title: Media Command Failure Details

panels.description: Warnings and errors for this user with no room_id in the selected interval. They are not included in room-scoped totals and cannot be attributed to the selected room. This preserves older or incomplete failure evidence.

targets.expr: {service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id="" | level=~"WARN|ERROR"

panels.title: User Warnings Without Room Attribution

panels.description: Retained room creation, destruction and bulk-disconnect events plus lifecycle events for the selected user in that room.

targets.expr: {service_name="o-sfu"} | label_format user_match=`{{ $id := "${user_id:percentencode}" | urldecode }}{{ or (eq .user_id $id) (eq .user_id (printf "Integer(%s)" $id)) (eq .user_id (printf "String(%q)" $id)) }}` | user_match="true" | drop user_match | room_id=${room_id:doublequote} | event=~"user\\.joined|user\\.closed|user\\.disconnected|publish\\.committed|publication\\.activity_changed|subscription\\.activity_changed|subscribe\\.succeeded|transport\\.health\\.changed"

panels.title: Retained Lifecycle Events

panels.description: Current HTTP snapshot, independent of the selected historical interval. A missing room or user returns HTTP 404. Authentication and query failures remain visible as errors. Sampled means at least one quality observation exists, not that it is fresh. The API does not expose quality sample age. Unavailable values stay blank or Not observed. Soft-pause remaining time is rounded down and clamped to zero after expiry.
panels.title: Current User Transport and Latest Quality Samples

panels.description: Current publications owned by the live user.
panels.title: Current Publications

panels.description: Current receiver routes, independent of the time picker. Match Source and SelectedEncoding to the source encoding table. SelectionActive and DeliveryAllowed describe control state, not proof of packet delivery. Missing RID, encoding, pause reason or upgrade values are unavailable or inapplicable. Upgrade remaining time is clamped to zero after expiry.
panels.title: Current Subscriptions

panels.description: Current room diagnostics projected into users, sources and subscription paths. Shows the selected user and their producers and receivers through media workers. An absent user has no graph. The time picker does not replay topology. Missing rooms return HTTP 404. Missing source or user observations remain visible as placeholders.
panels.title: Current User Media Topology

panels.description: Current sources in the selected room. Match Source to subscriptions and encodings. Packet and keyframe ages are observations at query time, not guarantees of delivery. Missing observations remain unavailable. H.264 IDR freshness is not observable in this packet path.
panels.title: Current Room Sources

panels.description: One row per source encoding. Match Source and Encoding to the selected receiver route above. A recent packet with an older keyframe can support VP8 decoder-recovery investigation. A keyframe age by itself does not prove a freeze. H.264 IDR observations and absent samples remain unavailable.

targets.root_selector: .sources[] as $source | $source.encodings[] | {sourceId: $source.sourceId, ownerUserId: $source.ownerUserId, streamId: $source.streamId, encodingId, rid, codec, lastPacketAgeMs, lastKeyframeAgeMs}

panels.title: Current Source Encodings
